title: Made from cheapest materials possible
text:
Made from cheapest materials possible. We purchased this pullout shelf because it would fit our narrow cabinet perfect, and it did. Unfortunately, its product quality is based on the lowest possible grades of materials possible. The threads were not cut clean, meaning matching nuts were hard or in one case impossible to get on. The template they provided was not as accurate as one would expect. 1/8 of an inch may not seem like much, but that ruins alignment. Remember this is a narrow cabinet, no room for slop. I've contacted their customer support; we will see if they can make the one rod that has a bad thread right.

Made in China.

Final note, the shelf does work, does fit (perfect), will hold up to the small items that can fit on it.

features: 【Perfect for Narrow Cabinets】This narrow pull out cabinet can be installed between two cabinets, fits 9½ inches wide cabinets. Our Slide out cabinet organizer dimensions measure 5" Wide x 18" Depth x 17.5” Height. Requires at least 6½ inch inner wide openings（inner wide must be measure from the hinges）, 21 inch inner depth and 19.5½ inch inner height .

【Maximize Your Cabinet Space】This pull out shelf makes it easier for you to arrange your spices while also keeping things better organized. No more back-breaking bending over and shifting items around to get to what you want. It can be used for any kitchen item from wine bottles, spices and seasoning bottles to various sauces

【Easy to Install】This narrow pull out cabinet organizer is going to be easily inserted into your kitchen. A template for attaching the "runners" to the floor of the cabinet is easy to use, you can complete installation with just a few simple screws coming with item.
【Smooth and Durable】The 4 connecting rods are solid material, industrial-grade ball bearing glide system ensured a smooth and quiet sliding system every time. The maximum load is 100 pounds.

【Warranty & Service】90 days warranty. If you are not satisfied with the item you received, please feel free to contact us, our warehouse is in local US, all your issues will be resolved in a better way.
